newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Heavy shares extend losses.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Heavy shares extend losses.

text.p: Shares in Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd extended recent losses in Thursday morning trade as investors were worried about the impact on the firm's business of a fire at a nuclear fuel reprocessing plant north of Tokyo on Tuesday, brokers said.
As of 0123 GMT, the shares were down 20 yen at 783 yen.
The issue has been losing ground in recent sessions after Nomura Research Institute downgraded it to a "2" from a "1" in February.
The company is expected to be hurt by falling prices of power plant equipment and environment-related equipment, Nomura Research said.
Moreover, the company may be negatively affected by possible cuts in capital outlay by electric utility companies amid growing public criticism of utility charges, Nomura Research said.
